messages:
marta: FYI found ~11 pending credit_memos after last night's billing.post_usage_aggregate run. Stripe shows customer credits, but NetSuite apply step errored out.

fin-bot: NetSuite sync job error: credit_memo 123456 apply -> 422 Unprocessable Entity: "applyAmount must be greater than 0" (attempts=3).

samir: looks like the new 'usage_offset' rows use negative amounts to indicate credits. Mapper currently negates offsets then a later normalizer flips sign again -> final payload has negative applyAmount.

elaine: that would produce the 422. Can we pause the apply phase so we don't create more pending memos?

ops-jen: I can toggle the NS_APPLY_ENABLED flag for tonight. Need confirmation from finance ops.

marta: confirm pause. we'll reconcile once fix is live.

nina: accounting: please provide list of affected customers so we can cross-check balances.

samir: I'll remove the double-negation and add unit tests. also adding an idempotency_key field to credit_memos and including it in NetSuite payloads to prevent double-apply on retries. Opening PR now.

fin-bot: deploy triggered -> billing-service v2.14.6 to staging.

ops-jen: NS_APPLY_ENABLED=false set. will monitor logs and prevent apply attempts for existing partial payloads.

marta: creating FIN-447 with affected account list and reconciliation sheet. after staging smoke we'll deploy fix and run a one-off reapply job to mark the pending memos as applied.

samir: PR: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/812 (fix + tests + migration). planning to deploy to prod 04:00 UTC after sign-offs.

marta: thanks everyone. please DM if any customers report invoice discrepancies. Closing thread after backfill verification. :white_check_mark:
